decisions.statement: A file is folded only over the bytes appended after the last read.
The fold is the drawn corpus rather than a cursor.
The bytes after the last newline are folded in and journalled.
A journalled record is taken back out before those bytes are read again.
A file no longer reading as that file did where the fold stopped is folded from its first byte.
A read says which files that read folded from their first byte.
The subagent roll is taken again only when the directory's mtime moves.
A fold for a file no longer in the roll is dropped.
A read says how many bytes that read folded and how many bytes remain.
The entries a read answers are the reader's own arrays.
A caller reads an answered array before that caller asks for the next read.
Nothing here is written to disk.

definition: one fold per transcript file, advanced over the bytes appended since the last read
